Be careful chasing coins tied to narratives that are dependent on news and headlines.

e.g. have seen a lot of people chasing GTA VI coins

one of the most popular narratives has been what the name of the in game currency will be

the issue with this type of narrative is - the in game currency will have NOTHING to do with any of the memes being made about it...

the only people who will initially be interested in stacking a meme about it instead of stacking the actual in game currency itself are already trading it

could a winner eventually pick up more steam as the trenches as a whole pick back up?

sure!

but odds are - most events like this in this type of market end up being sell the news and require a decent amount of distribution and time before they continue to send higher

if you're fine with that and want to try and nail the exact top of the narrative, no worries

Rockstar President, Sam Houser issue a new statement in a rare interview with GTA 6 launching:

“Rockstar Games was founded on the belief that games could achieve the same distinction as all other forms of storytelling, become essential to modern culture, and to be thought of as stories and worlds that live on with us.

This week, Grand Theft Auto returns to Leonida and modern-day Vice City. While things have changed and time has passed, one aspect holds true: We have tried to create an experience that will exceed your expectations while showing what this medium is capable of, and why we believe games are so special.

Whether you can trace your journey to this game through the entire series or are experiencing Grand Theft Auto for the first time, this is a narrative set in a world of possibilities – and it is up to you as the player to shape how it ultimately feels, and concludes. We hope it feels both familiar and entirely new, and above all, we hope you have fun.

We look forward to many more years of sharing these experiences with you.”

(Source: https://www.gamesradar.com/games/grand-theft-auto/as-gta-6-finally-releases-rockstar-boss-sam-houser-issues-rare-statement-we-are-incredibly-grateful-and-look-forward-to-many-more-years-of-sharing-these-experiences-with-you/)
